title: Reports of Israel airstrikes on Rafah as Gaza ceasefire deal comes under threat
summary: Air force reportedly carries out attack after Hamas militants emerge from tunnels and shoot at Israeli soldiers Middle East crisis – live updates The Israeli air force carried out airstrikes in Rafah in southern Gaza on Sunday, Israeli media reported, in the most serious threat so far to the week-long ceasefire in the strip. The airstrikes reportedly occurred after Hamas militants emerged from tunnels in the Rafah area and shot at Israeli soldiers in the morning, prompting a firefight. Israel’s army radio reported that deadly clashes in Rafah were continuing. Continue reading...
